notes: S1-FIX5 X7/§12.2 check 1 (decision 2026-11-12 #3): SignedData.signerInfos carries a second SignerInfo (a copy with another signature value, outside every signature) in DER order; RFC 3161 §2.4.2 allows no signature other than the TSA's, so check 1d requires exactly one SignerInfo (X7/M2). The receipt is otherwise fully re-signed with the test TSA key, so the only defect is that check-1 rule: invalid with E_TS_SCHEMA and gen_time null.
